subject: equipment_cleaning_and_sanitization
statement: Equipment cleaning and sanitization procedure: (1) Verify all equipment calibration certificates are current and within acceptable limits; (2) Complete environmental monitoring checks and confirm area is within specification; (3) Review and sign Batch Manufacturing Record (BMR) prior to commencing operations; (4) Perform equipment cleaning and sanitization according to the approved batch record instructions; (5) Record all process parameters, observations, and measurements in the BMR in real time; (6) Collect in-process samples at defined intervals and submit to QC for testing; (7) Any deviation from this procedure must be immediately reported to the supervisor and documented per SOP QA-DEV-4150-18; (8) Upon completion, clean and sanitize all equipment and workspace per SOP QA-CLN-1750-94.
